bins: density quartiles; radial and NN deciles; whole source embryo scopes; linear quantiles; searchsorted right
density: 10th within-embryo nearest chord distance excluding self
law: uniform without replacement exact observed anchor count per fixed stratum; refit q25 radius around randomized anchors
local_NN: nearest other cell within source embryo
radial: Euclidean distance from unrenormalized mean of observed source anchors
